---
name: Bug report
about: Report unexpected behavior in the workbench, adapter or package.
---

## Environment

Package versions, .NET SDK, database provider and browser (if applicable).

## Reproduction

Describe the smallest steps on disposable data. Include the relevant OpenAPI fragment or endpoint registration when helpful.

## Expected and observed behavior

For a Preview issue, include what a separate read returned afterwards. Redact credentials and private data. Report security issues privately using SECURITY.md.
